guarantees.claim: The most significant WidthPRDKey bits of unused_prd_masking (slice [WidthPRDMasking-1 -: WidthPRDKey]) are combinationaly driven by prd_key_expand whenever the enclosing generate block is active.

assumptions.claim: WidthPRDMasking is greater than or equal to WidthPRDKey, making the vector slice valid.
assumptions.cond: when the generate block enables this assignment
assumptions.risk: if violated, the part-select is illegal, leading to a compilation or simulation error, possibly masking failure.

uncertain_points.claim: The lower (WidthPRDMasking - WidthPRDKey) bits of unused_prd_masking are not assigned in this chunk and must be driven by another block. The assertion prd_masking == unused_prd_masking therefore depends on external logic matching the slice assignment.
uncertain_points.cond: always during operation when the assertion is active
uncertain_points.risk: If the lower bits are misdriven or if prd_masking is not connected to unused_prd_masking, the assertion AesMskgPrdExtraction will fire, indicating a masking or connection bug.
